name: Sage Eucalyptus

yarn.description: Cotton yarn for covered stem and rounded leaves

gauge: Gauge is not critical because the wire establishes the branch length. Keep the stem stitches firm and even so the wire is fully covered.

steps.label: Preparation
steps.text: Cut the wire to 20 cm. Use pliers to bend a small closed loop at each end. Join yarn at one loop, leaving a 10 cm tail, and work towards the opposite loop.

steps.label: Positions 1-11
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 9 positions. At the next position, sc around wire; ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in last ch; work along opposite side of ch: dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the stem sc just made. Lay this leaf to the left. At the next position, make the same leaf and lay it to the right.

steps.label: Positions 12-19
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 6 positions. At the next position, make a leaf: sc around wire; ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in last ch; work along opposite side of ch: dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the stem sc just made. Lay it to the right. At the next position, make the same leaf and lay it to the left.

steps.label: Positions 20-27
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 6 positions. At the next position, make a leaf: sc around wire; ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in last ch; work along opposite side of ch: dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the stem sc just made. Lay it to the left. At the next position, make the same leaf and lay it to the right.

steps.label: Positions 28-35
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 6 positions. At the next position, make a leaf: sc around wire; ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in last ch; work along opposite side of ch: dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the stem sc just made. Lay it to the right. At the next position, make the same leaf and lay it to the left.

steps.label: Positions 36-43
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 6 positions. At the next position, make a leaf: sc around wire; ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in last ch; work along opposite side of ch: dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the stem sc just made. Lay it to the left. At the next position, make the same leaf and lay it to the right.

steps.label: Positions 44-51
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 6 positions. At the next position, make a leaf: sc around wire; ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in last ch; work along opposite side of ch: dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the stem sc just made. Lay it to the right. At the next position, make the same leaf and lay it to the left.

steps.label: Positions 52-60
steps.text: Sc around the wire in each of the next 9 positions, ending at the lower wire loop.

finishing: Fasten off at the lower wire loop, leaving an 8 cm yarn tail.
Weave the lower yarn tail through the final stem stitches and trim it close to the fabric.
Weave the starting yarn tail into the upper stem stitches and trim it close to the fabric.
Gently curve the wired stem and angle each leaf away from the stem for a natural eucalyptus spray.
Check that both wire loops remain enclosed by the yarn covering and cannot catch on surrounding work.
notes: To sc around wire, hold the wire above the working yarn and insert the hook beneath the wire before completing each sc.
The alternating leaf placement gives the branch a balanced, softly rounded silhouette. Adjust the final leaf angles after shaping the stem.
